import json

with open('/handoff/handoff.json') as f:
    handoff = json.load(f)

milestones = handoff['ports']['plan']['milestones']
for m in milestones:
    print(f"=== {m['id']} ===")
    print(f"Title: {m['title']}")
    print(f"Observable: {m['observable']}")
    print(f"Public names: {m['public_names']}")
    print(f"Requires: {m['requires']}")
    print()
